events.text: The Elgin Theatre began serving as one of the hosts to the annual Toronto International Film Festival.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Since 1980 , the Elgin Theatre has served as one of the hosts to the annual Toronto International Film Festival .

events.text: The Ontario Heritage Foundation bought the structure from Famous Players.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1981 , the Ontario Heritage Foundation bought the structure from Famous Players .

events.text: The musical Cats was presented in the essentially unrestored Elgin.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From March 1985 through March 1987 the musical Cats was very successfully presented in the essentially unrestored Elgin

events.text: The presentation of Cats at the Elgin ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From March 1985 through March 1987 the musical Cats was very successfully presented in the essentially unrestored Elgin

events.text: The building closed for a full restoration.

events.quote: The building closed in 1987 for a full restoration

events.text: The first production LARES system was installed in the Elgin Theatre.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1991 , Dr . David Griesinger and Steve Barbar of Lexicon , Inc. , at the request of acousticians Neil Muncy and Robert Tanner , installed the first production LARES system

events.text: The Elgin Theatre housed the world premiere of the Napoleon musical.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The Elgin Theatre housed the world premiere of the Napoleon musical in 1994

events.text: The Elgin Theatre was home to The Who's Tommy musical.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1995 , it was home to The Whos Tommy musical .

events.text: Ross Petty Productions began staging pantomimes at the Elgin Theatre each Christmas season.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Since 1996 , Ross Petty Productions has staged pantomimes at the Elgin Theatre each Christmas season .

events.text: Conan O'Brien taped four episodes of NBC's Late Night with Conan O'Brien from the Elgin Theatre.
